勾選要比較的煉廠（至少兩家），下面的規模、主要區別、流程圖和對照表會跟著更新。: Pick the refineries to compare (at least two). The scale figures, key differences, flow diagram and comparison table below update as you choose.
條形長度按五家中的最大值比例: bar length relative to the largest of the five
方塊下的圓點代表所選各廠，實心＝有，空心＝沒有: dots under each box stand for the selected plants: filled = has it, hollow = does not
所選煉廠的流程對照圖: Flow diagram comparing the selected refineries
數字為萬噸/年，藍字為出率（產量÷原油加工量），加底線的是該行最高；底色標出有的: figures in 10⁴ t/yr; blue is yield (output ÷ crude runs), underlined is the highest in the row; shaded rows are units some plants have and others lack (or run a different process)
出率＝設計產能÷原油加工能力，屬於設計口徑，實際運轉會隨原油、負荷和檢修變化；加: Yield = design capacity ÷ crude capacity. It is a design-basis figure; actual operation varies with crude slate, run rates and turnarounds. For process units the percentage is throughput as a share of crude runs, not a yield. Capacities come from environmental approvals, company filings and industry reports; some units were later expanded or redesigned, and items marked “to be verified” lack a consistent source. A blank or “✓” means the plant has the unit but no reliable capacity was found. Shenghong includes units at affiliates Sailboat (Sierbang), Hongwei and Honggang; ZPC's PTA and PET plants are off site.
從廠外買進的乙烷、丙烷、甲醇等輕質原料。: Ethane, propane, methanol and other light feeds bought from outside the plant.
補充乙烯裂解、丙烷脫氫或甲醇制烯烴的進料，降低對石腦油的依賴。: Top up feed for the steam cracker, PDH or MTO units and reduce reliance on naphtha.
全廠起點。民營大煉化以進口中東中質、重質含硫原油為主。: Where the whole plant starts. China's private mega-refiners mostly run imported Middle East medium and heavy sour crudes.
經蒸餾切成不同沸點的餾分，再分頭加工。: Distilled into cuts by boiling range, each then processed separately.
氣化原料，不進煉油主流程。: Gasification feed; it does not enter the refining train.
氣化後製氫氣和合成氣；全加氫型煉廠耗氫量很大，煤制氫比天然氣便宜。: Gasified to hydrogen and syngas. Fully hydroprocessing refineries use a lot of hydrogen, and coal-based hydrogen is cheaper than gas-based.
原油加熱到約360°C，在常壓塔內按沸點切割，不發生化學反應。: Crude is heated to about 360°C and split by boiling point in an atmospheric column. No chemical reaction takes place.
塔頂出輕烴和石腦油，側線出煤油、柴油，塔底的常壓渣油去減壓塔。: Light ends and naphtha leave the top, kerosene and diesel the side draws, and atmospheric residue from the bottom goes to the vacuum unit.
在真空下繼續蒸餾常壓渣油，避免高溫裂解結焦。: Distils atmospheric residue further under vacuum to avoid thermal cracking and coking.
拔出減壓蠟油（VGO），塔底剩下最重的減壓渣油。: Recovers vacuum gas oil (VGO); the heaviest vacuum residue is left at the bottom.
乾氣和液化氣，主要是C1到C4。: Dry gas and LPG, mostly C1 to C4.
脫硫後分離：乙烷、丙烷、丁烷是優質裂解料，丙烯和C4各有化工用途。: Separated after sweetening: ethane, propane and butane are premium cracker feed, while propylene and C4s have their own chemical uses.
約220°C以前的輕餾分。: The light cut boiling below about 220°C.
重石腦油去重整產芳烴，輕石腦油去乙烯裂解。兩頭都搶，是煉化一體化最關鍵的中間料。: Heavy naphtha goes to the reformer for aromatics, light naphtha to the steam cracker. Both sides compete for it, which makes it the key intermediate in an integrated complex.
加氫精製成航煤、柴油；化工型煉廠把大部分送去加氫裂化，轉成石腦油。: Hydrotreated into jet fuel and diesel. Chemicals-oriented refineries send most of it to hydrocracking to make naphtha.
減壓塔側線抽出的重餾分。: Heavy side cut from the vacuum column.
加氫裂化或催化裂化的主要進料，是轉化成輕質油和化工料的主力。: Main feed to hydrocrackers and FCC units, and the workhorse for making light products and chemical feed.
原油中最重的部分，富含硫、金屬和瀝青質。: The heaviest part of the crude, rich in sulfur, metals and asphaltenes.
怎麼處理渣油決定了全廠路線：加氫（多產輕油、少產焦）或焦化（投資低、產石油焦）。: How residue is handled sets the whole refinery's route: hydroprocessing (more light products, less coke) or coking (cheaper to build, makes petcoke).
收集各裝置的氣體，脫硫後按碳數分離成C2、C3、C4。: Collects gas from every unit, sweetens it and splits it by carbon number into C2, C3 and C4.
丙烯直接去下游，丙烷去脫氫，飽和輕烴去乙烯裂解，C4去MTBE和烷基化。: Propylene goes straight downstream, propane to dehydrogenation, saturated light ends to the steam cracker and C4s to MTBE and alkylation.
加氫脫除硫、氮，保護重整催化劑。: Hydrotreating removes sulfur and nitrogen to protect the reformer catalyst.
精製後的重石腦油進連續重整。: Treated heavy naphtha feeds the CCR reformer.
高壓加氫，把柴油餾分裂化成更輕的組分。: High-pressure hydrocracking of the diesel cut into lighter components.
產重石腦油（去重整）、航煤和少量清潔柴油。這是「少產柴油、多產芳烴」的關鍵裝置。: Makes heavy naphtha (to the reformer), jet fuel and a little clean diesel. It is the key unit for “less diesel, more aromatics”.
蠟油在高壓氫氣下裂化，產品硫含量極低。: VGO is cracked under high-pressure hydrogen; the products contain very little sulfur.
重石腦油去重整，航煤外售，加氫尾油是優質乙烯裂解料。: Heavy naphtha goes to the reformer, jet fuel is sold, and unconverted oil is premium steam-cracker feed.
重油在催化劑上裂化，不耗氫。催化裂解（DCC）是多產丙烯的版本。: Heavy oil cracks over a catalyst without hydrogen. Deep catalytic cracking (DCC) is the propylene-maximising version.
產汽油組分、液化氣（富含丙烯）和柴油；油漿去焦化或作燃料。: Makes gasoline blendstock, propylene-rich LPG and diesel; slurry oil goes to the coker or to fuel.
用丙烷、丁烷等溶劑把渣油裡的瀝青質萃取分離出來。: Uses propane, butane or similar solvents to extract asphaltenes from residue.
脫瀝青油回加氫裂化，脫油瀝青作氣化原料或燃料。: Deasphalted oil returns to hydrocracking; the pitch is used as gasifier feed or fuel.
渣油加氫脫硫、脫金屬並部分裂化。固定床轉化率低，沸騰床、漿態床轉化率高。: Removes sulfur and metals from residue and partly cracks it. Fixed-bed units convert little; ebullated-bed and slurry-phase units convert much more.
產出加氫重油（去催化裂化）、蠟油和石腦油；脫下的硫回收成硫磺。: Produces hydrotreated resid (to the FCC), gas oil and naphtha; the sulfur removed is recovered as elemental sulfur.
渣油高溫熱裂化，把碳以石油焦形式脫掉。: Cracks residue thermally at high temperature and rejects carbon as petcoke.
產焦化汽柴油、焦化蠟油（都要再加氫）和石油焦。: Makes coker naphtha and diesel, coker gas oil (all need hydrotreating) and petcoke.
煤或石油焦氣化、變換、提純得到氫氣。: Gasifies coal or petcoke, then shifts and purifies the gas into hydrogen.
供全廠加氫裝置；重整副產氫不夠用時由它補足。: Supplies the hydroprocessing units and makes up whatever reformer hydrogen cannot cover.
丙烷在催化劑上脫掉一分子氫變成丙烯。: Propane loses a hydrogen molecule over a catalyst and becomes propylene.
專產丙烯，副產氫氣。: Dedicated propylene maker, with hydrogen as a by-product.
輕烴、石腦油、加氫尾油在800°C以上與蒸汽一起裂解。: Light ends, naphtha and unconverted oil are cracked with steam above 800°C.
產乙烯、丙烯、混合C4（含丁二烯）和裂解汽油（富含苯）。: Makes ethylene, propylene, mixed C4s (with butadiene) and pyrolysis gasoline (rich in benzene).
甲醇在分子篩催化劑上轉化成乙烯和丙烯。: Converts methanol into ethylene and propylene over a zeolite catalyst.
不靠原油的烯烴來源。: An olefin source that does not depend on crude.
把重石腦油中的環烷烴、鏈烷烴轉成芳烴，催化劑連續再生。: Turns the naphthenes and paraffins in heavy naphtha into aromatics, with continuous catalyst regeneration.
重整生成油去芳烴聯合裝置；副產大量氫氣，是全廠最便宜的氫源。: Reformate goes to the aromatics complex. It also yields plenty of hydrogen, the cheapest hydrogen source on site.
由催化汽油、重整汽油、烷基化油、MTBE等調和而成。: Blended from FCC gasoline, reformate, alkylate, MTBE and other components.
加氫裂化和煤油加氫的產品。: Product of hydrocracking and kerosene hydrotreating.
航空燃料，成品油中需求增長較好的一種。: Aviation fuel, one of the faster-growing refined products.
車用、船用燃料。化工型煉廠盡量壓低柴油產量。: Road and marine fuel. Chemicals-oriented refineries keep diesel output as low as they can.
低硫焦做預焙陽極、負極材料；高硫焦作燃料或氣化制氫。: Low-sulfur coke goes into prebaked anodes and battery anode material; high-sulfur coke is burned as fuel or gasified for hydrogen.
各加氫裝置脫下的硫化氫經克勞斯法回收。: Hydrogen sulfide removed in the hydroprocessing units is recovered by the Claus process.
製硫酸、化肥。加工高硫原油的煉廠產量很大。: Used for sulfuric acid and fertiliser. Refineries running sour crude produce a lot of it.
來自乙烯裂解、催化裂化氣分和丙烷脫氫。: Comes from the steam cracker, the FCC gas plant and PDH.
聚丙烯、丙烯腈、環氧丙烷、苯酚丙酮的原料。: Feed for polypropylene, acrylonitrile, propylene oxide and phenol/acetone.
石化工業最基礎的原料。: The most basic building block of the petrochemical industry.
聚乙烯、EVA、乙二醇、苯乙烯的原料。: Feed for polyethylene, EVA, ethylene glycol and styrene.
裂解和催化的C4餾分，先抽提丁二烯。: C4 cut from the cracker and FCC; butadiene is extracted first.
丁二烯做合成橡膠和ABS；剩下的異丁烯做MTBE，其餘去烷基化。: Butadiene goes into synthetic rubber and ABS; the remaining isobutylene makes MTBE and the rest goes to alkylation.
抽提、歧化、異構化、吸附分離一整套，把混合芳烴盡量轉成對二甲苯。: Extraction, disproportionation, isomerisation and adsorptive separation in one train, converting as much of the mixed aromatics as possible into paraxylene.
丙烯氨氧化制得，副產氫氰酸和乙腈。: Made by ammoxidation of propylene, with hydrogen cyanide and acetonitrile as by-products.
腈綸、ABS、碳纖維原絲；副產氫氰酸可做MMA。: Acrylic fibre, ABS and carbon-fibre precursor; the by-product hydrogen cyanide can make MMA.
丙烯氧化制得，常與苯乙烯聯產（PO/SM法）。: Made by oxidising propylene, often co-produced with styrene (PO/SM process).
乙烯氧化成環氧乙烷，再水合成乙二醇。: Ethylene is oxidised to ethylene oxide, which is then hydrated to ethylene glycol.
乙二醇和PTA一起聚合成PET；環氧乙烷做表面活性劑、減水劑。: Glycol and PTA polymerise into PET; ethylene oxide goes into surfactants and concrete admixtures.
C4中的異丁烯與甲醇醚化，醚化前後的C4分別叫醚前、醚後C4。: Isobutylene in the C4 cut is etherified with methanol. The C4 stream before and after this step is called pre-ether and post-ether C4.
高辛烷值汽油組分；MTBE裂解可得高純異丁烯做MMA；醚後C4去烷基化。: High-octane gasoline component. Cracking MTBE gives high-purity isobutylene for MMA; post-ether C4 goes to alkylation.
來自芳烴聯合裝置和裂解汽油。: Comes from the aromatics complex and pyrolysis gasoline.
苯乙烯、苯酚、己內酰胺的原料。: Feed for styrene, phenol and caprolactam.
芳烴聯合裝置的主產品，民營大煉化的建廠初衷。: Main product of the aromatics complex, and the reason the private mega-refiners were built.
幾乎全部用來生產PTA。: Almost all of it goes into PTA.
可由異丁烯氧化，或由丙酮和氫氰酸（ACH法）制得。: Made by oxidising isobutylene, or from acetone and hydrogen cyanide (ACH route).
聚合成PMMA（壓克力），用於導光板、車燈、塗料。: Polymerised into PMMA (acrylic) for light-guide panels, car lamps and coatings.
注塑件、薄膜、纖維、汽車和家電部件。: Injection mouldings, film, fibre, and car and appliance parts.
乙烯和醋酸乙烯高壓共聚。: High-pressure copolymer of ethylene and vinyl acetate.
光伏組件封裝膠膜、電纜料、發泡鞋材。: Solar-module encapsulant film, cable compounds and foamed footwear.
乙烯聚合。全密度裝置可在HDPE和LLDPE之間切換，LDPE用高壓法。: Polymerised ethylene. Swing units switch between HDPE and LLDPE; LDPE uses a high-pressure process.
薄膜、管材、中空容器、電纜料。: Film, pipe, blow-moulded containers and cable compounds.
醚後C4中的異丁烷和丁烯在酸催化下合成。: Made from the isobutane and butenes in post-ether C4 over an acid catalyst.
無硫、無芳烴、無烯烴的高辛烷值汽油調和組分，回到汽油池。: A high-octane gasoline blendstock free of sulfur, aromatics and olefins, sent back to the gasoline pool.
苯和乙烯先合成乙苯，再脫氫。: Benzene and ethylene make ethylbenzene, which is then dehydrogenated.
苯和丙烯合成異丙苯，氧化後得到苯酚和丙酮。: Benzene and propylene make cumene, which is oxidised into phenol and acetone.
兩者合成雙酚A，再做聚碳酸酯和環氧樹脂；丙酮還可做MMA。: Together they make bisphenol A for polycarbonate and epoxy resin; acetone can also make MMA.
PX在醋酸溶劑中用空氣氧化，再加氫精製。: PX is oxidised with air in acetic acid, then purified by hydrogenation.
聚酯（PET、PBT、PBAT）的主要原料。: Main feed for polyesters (PET, PBT, PBAT).
丙烯腈、丁二烯、苯乙烯三元共聚。: Terpolymer of acrylonitrile, butadiene and styrene.
家電外殼、汽車內飾、電子產品。: Appliance housings, car interiors and electronics.
雙酚A與碳酸二苯酯（或光氣）聚合。: Bisphenol A polymerised with diphenyl carbonate (or phosgene).
透明工程塑膠：車燈、板材、電子外殼。: Transparent engineering plastic for car lamps, sheet and electronics housings.
PTA和乙二醇縮聚，先得到聚酯切片。: PTA and glycol are polycondensed, first into polyester chips.
切片紡成滌綸長絲、短纖，或做瓶片、薄膜。: Chips are spun into polyester filament and staple fibre, or made into bottle resin and film.
PTA與丁二醇縮聚得PBT；再加入己二酸共聚得PBAT。: PTA and butanediol make PBT; adding adipic acid as a comonomer gives PBAT.
PBT是工程塑膠（連接器、汽車部件）；PBAT是可降解塑膠（購物袋、地膜）。: PBT is an engineering plastic (connectors, car parts); PBAT is biodegradable (shopping bags, mulch film).
榮盛石化控股 · 浙江舟山魚山島: controlled by Rongsheng Petrochemical · Yushan Island, Zhoushan, Zhejiang
榮盛石化51%、桐昆20%、巨化20%、舟山海投9%: Rongsheng Petrochemical 51%, Tongkun 20%, Juhua 20%, Zhoushan Marine Investment 9%
一期2019年，二期2022年全面投產: Phase 1 in 2019; phase 2 fully online in 2022
固定床渣油加氫＋重油催化裂化＋延遲焦化，二期起加上漿態床渣油加氫裂化；加氫和脫碳: Fixed-bed resid hydrotreating + resid FCC + delayed coking, with slurry-phase resid hydrocracking added from phase 2. It runs both hydrogen-addition and carbon-rejection routes.
全球單廠規模最大的煉化一體化基地之一。PX不在島上做PTA，而是供給榮盛系的逸盛: One of the world's largest single-site integrated refining and chemical complexes. Its PX is not turned into PTA on the island; it goes to Rongsheng's affiliate Yisheng Petrochemical.
煤和自產石油焦一起氣化，供氫氣和合成氣。: Coal and the plant's own petcoke are gasified together for hydrogen and syngas.
兩期各兩套1000萬噸常減壓。: Two 10 Mt/yr crude units in each phase.
一期500萬噸固定床渣油加氫脫硫；二期及後續改造新增漿態床渣油加氫裂化。: Phase 1 has a 5 Mt/yr fixed-bed resid desulfurizer; phase 2 and later revamps added slurry-phase resid hydrocracking.
三套裂解合計420萬噸乙烯。: Three crackers with 4.2 Mt/yr of ethylene in total.
成品油收率不到四成，其餘都是化工品。: Refined-fuel yield is under 40%; the rest is chemicals.
部分自用於氣化制氫。: Partly gasified on site for hydrogen.
全球最大的PX生產基地之一。: One of the world's largest PX production bases.
與苯乙烯聯產（待核實規模）。: Co-produced with styrene (capacity to be verified).
PX主要供應榮盛參股的逸盛石化（寧波、大連、海南）的PTA裝置，不在魚山島內。: PX mainly supplies the PTA plants of Rongsheng affiliate Yisheng Petrochemical (Ningbo, Dalian, Hainan), not on Yushan Island.
新增140萬噸乙烯計畫配套。: Part of the added 1.4 Mt/yr ethylene project.
榮盛、恆逸、桐昆等股東方的聚酯工廠。: Polyester plants owned by shareholders such as Rongsheng, Hengyi and Tongkun.
恆力石化 · 遼寧大連長興島: Hengli Petrochemical · Changxing Island, Dalian, Liaoning
恆力石化（恆力集團）全資: Wholly owned by Hengli Petrochemical (Hengli Group)
沸騰床渣油加氫裂化＋溶劑脫瀝青。不建催化裂化，也不建焦化，全加氫流程: Ebullated-bed resid hydrocracking + solvent deasphalting. No FCC and no coker: a fully hydroprocessing scheme.
一切為PX服務：柴油、蠟油、渣油都加氫裂化成重石腦油去重整。耗氫巨大，所以配了煤: Everything serves PX: diesel, gas oil and residue are all hydrocracked into heavy naphtha for the reformers. Hydrogen demand is huge, hence coal-based hydrogen. PX is turned into PTA and polyester on site.
年加工煤炭約500萬噸，同時聯產甲醇、醋酸。: Processes about 5 Mt/yr of coal and co-produces methanol and acetic acid.
處理沸騰床的未轉化油。: Handles unconverted oil from the ebullated-bed units.
沸騰床加氫裂化，渣油轉化率遠高於固定床。: Ebullated-bed hydrocracking converts far more residue than fixed-bed units.
進料以煉廠乾氣、乙烷、液化氣和加氫尾油為主，石腦油用量少。: Fed mainly with refinery dry gas, ethane, LPG and unconverted oil; little naphtha.
重整能力960萬噸，是PX產量的基礎。: 9.6 Mt/yr of reforming capacity, the basis of its PX output.
設計450萬噸，實際產能已超過設計值。: Designed for 4.5 Mt/yr; actual capacity now exceeds design.
長興島PTA約1200萬噸，另有惠州基地；PX管道直供。: About 12 Mt/yr of PTA on Changxing Island plus a Huizhou site; PX is piped directly.
集團內聚酯切片、滌綸長絲、瓶片、薄膜。: Group polyester chips, filament, bottle resin and film.
恆力旗下康輝的PBT、PBAT。: PBT and PBAT from Hengli subsidiary Kanghui.
沸騰床渣油加氫＋延遲焦化（焦化規模待核實），不建催化裂化: Ebullated-bed resid hydroprocessing + delayed coking (coker size to be verified); no FCC
單系列1600萬噸常減壓為國內單套最大。原油、甲醇、丙烷三條原料路線並行：煉化之: Its single 16 Mt/yr crude unit is China's largest. Three feed routes run side by side: crude, methanol and propane. Besides the refinery, affiliate Sailboat (Sierbang) makes acrylonitrile, EVA and MMA from MTO and PDH.
斯爾邦石化外購甲醇和丙烷，不依賴原油。: Sailboat Petrochemical buys in methanol and propane and does not depend on crude.
用丙烯腈副產的氫氰酸，走ACH法。: Uses by-product HCN from acrylonitrile via the ACH route.
光伏級EVA的國內主要供應商。: A leading Chinese supplier of solar-grade EVA.
同在連雲港，PX就近供應。: Also in Lianyungang, supplied with PX next door.
南山集團主導，山東能源集團等參股: Led by Nanshan Group, with Shandong Energy Group and others as shareholders
2024年首套常減壓開車，其後陸續投產: First crude unit started in 2024; other units followed
渣油加氫（3×260，含漿態床）＋催化裂解（DCC），不建焦化: Resid hydroprocessing (3×260, including slurry-phase) + deep catalytic cracking (DCC); no coker

一套常壓、一套常減壓。: One atmospheric unit and one atmospheric-vacuum unit.

HDPE、LLDPE，另有超高分子量聚乙烯。: HDPE and LLDPE, plus ultra-high-molecular-weight PE.

五家中唯一有國際石油公司入股的。阿美鎖定原油供應（最多約21萬桶/日），總投資8: The only one of the five with an international oil company as shareholder. Aramco locks in crude supply (up to about 210 kb/d). Total investment is RMB 83.7 billion.

兩套45萬噸全密度聚乙烯，一套20萬噸HDPE。: Two 450 kt/yr swing PE units and one 200 kt/yr HDPE unit.

一期汽油277萬噸，佔一期原油的13.9%；二期汽油未查到，全廠出率暫不計算。汽: Phase 1 gasoline is 2.77 Mt/yr, 13.9% of phase 1 crude; phase 2 gasoline was not found, so no site-wide yield is calculated. Gasoline plus diesel for both phases is about 7.06 Mt/yr (17.7%), estimated as the refined-fuel yield minus jet fuel.

一期90＋二期90。按裝置產能計；丙烯還來自丙烷脫氫，並分給環氧丙烷、丙烯腈等，: Phase 1 90 + phase 2 90, on unit capacity. Propylene also comes from PDH and is shared with propylene oxide, acrylonitrile and others, so the actual yield depends on scheduling.
一期HDPE 30＋LLDPE 45；二期HDPE 35＋LLDPE 45＋LD: Phase 1: HDPE 30 + LLDPE 45; phase 2: HDPE 35 + LLDPE 45 + LDPE 40.

It reallocates gasoline, jet, diesel and chemical feed daily with the market, so published figures range from 15% to 53%: about 50% in the design product table and about 20% in a 2025 Xinhua report. 40%–50% is used for rough comparison.
乙烯產能。裂解裝置設計乙烯收率48%、雙烯（乙烯＋丙烯）收率60%，均以裂解原料: Ethylene capacity. The cracker is designed for 48% ethylene and 60% ethylene-plus-propylene yield, both on cracker feed.
化工輕油，送乙烯裂解。: Light chemical feed, sent to the steam cracker.
設計產品表；實際隨每日排產變動。: Design product table; actual output varies with daily scheduling.
乙烯配套42.26萬噸，加上STPP 20萬噸、JPP 20萬噸等專用料，合計約: 422.6 kt/yr tied to the cracker, plus specialty lines such as STPP 200 kt/yr and JPP 200 kt/yr, for about 800–850 kt/yr in total. Some propylene comes from the mixed dehydrogenation unit, so a crude-based yield is unreliable and is not calculated.
PTA需要的PX超過本廠產量，部分外購，不計出率。: PTA needs more PX than the plant makes, so some is bought in. No yield calculated.
研報產品方案：汽油277.6＋航煤169.7＋柴油48.8＝496萬噸。環評階段: Broker product plan: gasoline 2.776 + jet 1.697 + diesel 0.488 = 4.96 Mt/yr. About 51% at the environmental-approval stage, cut to 31% in the 2021 redesign.
斯爾邦，原料不來自原油，不計出率。: Sailboat; feed does not come from crude. No yield calculated.
斯爾邦外購丙烷，不計出率。: Sailboat buys in propane. No yield calculated.
柔性設計，成品油比例可在18%到40%之間調整，沒有單一設計值。: Flexible design: the refined-fuel share can be set anywhere from 18% to 40%, with no single design value.
全密度50＋HDPE 30＋超高分子量10，不含EVA/LDPE。: Swing PE 50 + HDPE 30 + UHMWPE 10, excluding EVA/LDPE.
設計成品油收率約29%到30%，年產約446萬噸。: Design refined-fuel yield is about 29% to 30%, around 4.46 Mt/yr.
%（裝置規模佔原油加工量）。: % (unit capacity as a share of crude runs).
裕龍的PX一欄是混合芳烴（混二甲苯），一期沒有建PX；成品油是18%到40%的柔: Yulong's PX figure is mixed aromatics (mixed xylenes); phase 1 has no PX. Its refined-fuel share is a flexible 18%–40% range, and the hollow part of the bar shows the adjustable span.

浙石化聚丙烯按兩期裝置產能計，實際分配隨排產變化。: ZPC's polypropylene is counted on the capacity of both phases; the actual split varies with scheduling.

2024年11月山東地煉產能約1.17億噸/年，佔全省煉能的66%；獨立煉廠從2: In November 2024 Shandong's independent refiners had about 117 Mt/yr of capacity, 66% of the province's total. Their number fell from 37 in 2015 to 19 in 2024.
2025年平均開工率約52%，明顯低於主營煉廠的72%左右，主要卡在原油進口配額: Average run rates in 2025 were about 52%, well below the roughly 72% at state-owned refineries, held back mainly by crude import quotas and fuel margins.
原油配額不夠時，地煉用不佔配額的燃料油、稀釋瀝青、外購蠟油頂替，所以渣油比例高、: When crude quotas run short, teapots substitute quota-free fuel oil, diluted bitumen and purchased gas oil. That is why their residue share is high, their cokers are large and they make a lot of petcoke.
整合與淘汰：裕龍島計畫整合10家地煉、退出約2700萬噸產能；200萬噸/年以下: Consolidation and closures: the Yulong Island project absorbed 10 teapots and retired about 27 Mt/yr of capacity, and refineries under 2 Mt/yr were due to close by the end of 2025. The province aims to cut teapot capacity to about 90 Mt/yr and the refined-fuel yield to about 40%.
2026年原油非國營貿易進口配額總量持平，新增部分主要給了大型一體化計畫，中小地: Non-state crude import quotas for 2026 are flat in total; new allocations went mainly to large integrated projects, while small and mid-sized teapots saw cuts. No Shandong teapot received a fuel export quota.
圖中百分比是典型地煉的經驗區間（佔原油加工量），不是某一家企業的實測或設計數值，: Percentages are typical ranges for a teapot refinery (share of crude runs), not measured or design figures for any one company; plants vary widely with crude quality, heavy-feed blending, configuration and run rates. Process units show throughput as a share of crude. “Where a tonne of crude goes” and “Blending pool make-up” use range midpoints and add up to 100%. Industry figures come from public reports by JLC, OilChem and others, whose bases differ somewhat. Dry gas, hydrogen, sulfur recovery and utilities are not drawn.
地煉主要原料，靠非國營貿易進口配額取得。: The teapots' main feed, obtained through non-state crude import quotas.
配額收緊時開工率隨之下降。: Run rates fall when quotas tighten.
塔頂出液化氣和石腦油（約220°C以前），側線出柴油，塔底的常壓渣油（地煉習慣叫: LPG and naphtha (up to about 220°C) leave the top, diesel the side draws, and atmospheric residue (which teapots call “fuel oil”) from the bottom goes to the vacuum unit.
不佔原油配額的重質原料，包括進口燃料油、稀釋瀝青、外購渣油。: Heavy feeds outside the crude quota: imported fuel oil, diluted bitumen and purchased residue.
和常壓渣油一起進減壓塔。摻得越多，渣油越多，石油焦和焦化負荷越大。: Fed to the vacuum column with atmospheric residue. The more is blended in, the more residue, petcoke and coker load.
在真空下繼續蒸餾常壓渣油，避免高溫結焦。: Distils atmospheric residue further under vacuum to avoid coking at high temperature.
側線出少量減壓柴油（減一線）和蠟油（360–540°C），塔底是減壓渣油。: Side draws give a little vacuum diesel (first vacuum cut) and gas oil (360–540°C); vacuum residue is left at the bottom.
從別的煉廠或貿易商買進的蠟油。: Gas oil bought from other refineries or traders.
直接補進催化裂化，提高催化負荷。: Goes straight into the cat cracker to raise its load.
把石腦油中的環烷烴、鏈烷烴轉成芳烴，辛烷值從60多提高到90以上。: Converts naphthenes and paraffins in naphtha into aromatics, raising octane from the 60s to above 90.
重整汽油是高辛烷值調和組分；副產氫氣，供加氫精製使用。: Reformate is a high-octane blendstock; the by-product hydrogen feeds the hydrotreaters.
從重整生成油抽提苯、甲苯、二甲苯。: Benzene, toluene and xylenes extracted from reformate.
外售做化工原料，抽餘油做溶劑油。: Sold as chemical feed; the raffinate becomes solvent oil.
蠟油在催化劑上裂化，不耗氫。地煉的核心裝置。: Gas oil cracks over a catalyst without hydrogen. The heart of a teapot refinery.
產催化汽油、催化柴油、富含丙烯的液化氣，塔底剩油漿（油渣）去焦化或做燃料油。: Makes FCC gasoline, FCC diesel and propylene-rich LPG; slurry oil from the bottom goes to the coker or into fuel oil.
蠟油在高壓氫氣下裂化。: Gas oil is cracked under high-pressure hydrogen.
多產航煤，少產柴油，是地煉壓減柴油的主要手段。: Makes more jet fuel and less diesel; the main way teapots cut diesel output.
液化氣脫硫後分出丙烯、C4；C4裡的異丁烯和甲醇做成MTBE，剩下的C4可做烷基: Sweetened LPG is split into propylene and C4s. Isobutylene in the C4s reacts with methanol to make MTBE, and the remaining C4s can make alkylate.
MTBE和烷基化油回汽油池；丙烯外售或做聚丙烯；其餘做民用液化氣。: MTBE and alkylate return to the gasoline pool; propylene is sold or made into PP; the rest becomes household LPG.
渣油和油漿高溫熱裂化，把碳以石油焦的形式脫掉。投資低，能吃最差的原料。: Thermally cracks residue and slurry oil, rejecting carbon as petcoke. Cheap to build and able to take the worst feeds.
產焦化汽油、焦化柴油（都要加氫）、焦化蠟油（回催化）和石油焦。: Makes coker gasoline and diesel (both need hydrotreating), coker gas oil (back to the FCC) and petcoke.
低硫焦做預焙陽極、負極材料；高硫焦作燃料。: Low-sulfur coke goes into prebaked anodes and battery anode material; high-sulfur coke is burned as fuel.
氣分出來的丙烯，部分企業自建聚丙烯。: Propylene from the gas plant; some refiners have their own PP units.
提走丙烯和C4後剩下的液化氣。: LPG left after propylene and C4s are taken out.
加氫裂化的煤油餾分。: The kerosene cut from the hydrocracker.
航空燃料，需求增長比汽柴油好。: Aviation fuel; demand is growing faster than for gasoline and diesel.
柴油池各組分經加氫精製後調和成國六柴油。: Diesel pool components are hydrotreated and blended to China VI diesel.
地煉傳統上最大的產品，近年需求見頂，是減產重點。: Traditionally the teapots' biggest product. Demand has peaked, so it is the main target for cuts.
各裝置產出的柴油組分在這裡匯合，加氫精製後調和。: Diesel components from every unit meet here and are hydrotreated before blending.
直餾柴油品質最好，催化柴油、焦化柴油要深度加氫。: Straight-run diesel is the best quality; FCC and coker diesel need deep hydrotreating.
焦化蠟油回催化: coker gas oil back to FCC
山東地煉的主流配置：常減壓配催化裂化和延遲焦化，靠脫碳轉化渣油，產品以汽油、柴油: The mainstream Shandong set-up: a crude/vacuum unit with a cat cracker and delayed coker, converting residue by carbon rejection and making mostly gasoline and diesel. Cheap to build and flexible on feed, but liquid yields are low, petcoke output is high and the diesel share is large.
其他：油漿和燃料油外售、道路瀝青、外售石腦油、硫磺等。: Other: slurry and fuel oil sales, road bitumen, naphtha sales, sulfur and so on.
在燃料型的基礎上加加氫裂化和丙烯、芳烴下游，走「減油增化」：柴油明顯減少，多出航: Adds a hydrocracker plus propylene and aromatics downstream to the fuels set-up, following the “less fuel, more chemicals” push: diesel falls clearly, jet fuel, aromatics and PP are added, and coker load drops. The refined-fuel yield is still far above the roughly 30% of the large integrated complexes.
其他：油漿和燃料油外售、道路瀝青、溶劑油、硫磺等。: Other: slurry and fuel oil sales, road bitumen, solvent oil, sulfur and so on.
催化汽油加氫脫硫後，與重整汽油、MTBE、烷基化油等調和成國六汽油。: FCC gasoline is desulfurized, then blended with reformate, MTBE, alkylate and other components to China VI gasoline.
各裝置產出的汽油組分在這裡匯合。催化汽油要加氫脫硫，重整汽油、MTBE、烷基化油: Gasoline components from every unit meet here. FCC gasoline must be desulfurized; reformate, MTBE and alkylate can be blended directly.
辛烷值靠重整汽油和MTBE、烷基化油拉高；焦化汽油辛烷值低，加氫後多送重整，直接: Reformate, MTBE and alkylate lift the octane. Coker gasoline has low octane; after hydrotreating it mostly goes to the reformer, and little is blended directly.
